Launch YC: Theo - The site-builder and engine that gets your business found | Y Combinator

# Theo - The site-builder and engine that gets your business found

Search is changing. The days of getting 30 pages of Google results (that you never scroll through anyway) are over. Today, AI agents give customers three choices. Max. Theo helps make sure your business is one of them.

Miles Pines

Theo

14 days ago

https://youtu.be/asxjV4jlCTY?si=gae61cXG75s7I2Kt

WHAT IS THEO?

Theo is like having an expert professional web guru working for you 24 hours a day. Those aren’t our words but the words of one of our customers. Theo is constantly analyzing where your potential customers are coming from and what they are searching for. Theo writes and publishes content automatically so you’re getting consistently ranked and your domain authority rises.

We’ve built 10,000+ sites since July with an average increase of over 50% in traffic and generated 100s of thousands of impressions.
payload.summary: Summary: Theo is a YC-backed site-builder and SEO engine that continuously analyzes where potential customers come from and what they search for, automatically writes and publishes content, and aims to boost domain authority and traffic. Since July, Theo has built 10,000+ sites with an average 50%+ traffic increase and hundreds of thousands of impressions. It positions itself as a 24/7 “web guru” to help your business be one of the top three AI-driven search results. If your query is about a YC company launching this week, Theo is the YC launch highlighted as a site-building and SEO tool designed to improve online visibility.
